jìn is the general reading in 尽力、尽头、无尽; jǐn remains in 尽管、尽早.

jiōng is not a current reading of 坷; it belongs to 坰.

guī belongs to archaic senses such as 傀然, not current 傀儡.

la is an older regional pronunciation associated with 苤蓝; standard usage has lán.
lè is widespread in 勒令、勒索 and names; lēi is the tightening verb.
yīng is not a single-character reading of 哩; 英里 begins with 英 yīng.
wáng is the archaic use corresponding to 亡, not current 芒.
ma is the older or regional spelling corresponding to 吗、嘛; retain current me and surname yāo.
míng is an older regional pronunciation; current standard usage has méng.
wǎn belongs to archaic 婉娩; modern childbirth vocabulary uses miǎn.

bō is an obsolete fish-description reading; modern 鲅鱼、鲅鱼圈 use bà.
鲶 is a variant of the common mainland form 鲇.
hú occurs in 鹘鹰、回鹘; gǔ is the specialized 鹘鸼 reading.
me in 什麽/怎麽 dominates; mó is literary in 幺麽, and ma is the 吗-particle variant.
